text_block_list.text:
Worried about King Halo not showing up for 
training, I went looking for her...

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
—Yes, at that time, I told the reporters 
this.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
"The wisest horse girl of all, the one 
truly worthy of being first-class—"

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
That it is this King Halo who will one day 
reign at the top of the world...

text_block_list.name: Cat-Eyed Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
As expected of King! I really admire that 
about you!

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
Oooohohohoho! Of course, it's no trouble 
at all.

text_block_list.name: King Halo
text_block_list.text:
From your family to your friends, I'll 
write as many as you need!
